'''Keighlah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] lieutenant and member of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]]. She was second in command to Captain [[Barden Golah]]. She lost her [[Keighlah's brother|brother]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] before she was [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|assigned]] to [[Mos Ila]]. In [[3643 BBY]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], after disabling the dampeners on an artifact being studied, she was killed, and her body taken as a vessel for [[the Imprisoned One]]. She soon started infecting other members of her team, until she was eventually killed by an Imperial individual.<ref name="TOR" />
